title: JKSSB aspirants protest, seek cancellation of upcoming exams

ai.summary: Aspirants of JKSSB protest in New Delhi demanding cancellation of upcoming exams, citing the Centre's failure to restore J&K statehood as promised.

facts.claim: Aspirants of JKSSB protest in New Delhi
facts.quote: JKSSB aspirants protest, seek cancellation of upcoming exams

facts.claim: citing the Centre's failure to restore J&K statehood as promised
facts.quote: J&K lost statehood in 2019, when it was split into two union territories. The elected government and the Congress say the Centre has not kept its promise to restore it, and protested in July 2026.
